note: Private RV campground/marina at St. Marys (Pleasants Co) where Middle Island Creek meets the Ohio River. Aggregators describe 57 cement-pad full-hookup sites (30/50-amp), big-rig friendly, with direct river/marina docking; RV sites adjacent to the water. Reserve via Facebook Messenger; favors longer stays. --Claude  Phone/Facebook Messenger only - call (304) 588-1955 (or Jane Wilson 304-684-5635 / 304-483-6880); no online booking system (not on recreation.gov/ReserveAmerica/Campspot). The old stmarysdock.com domain no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN, 2026-10-21). --Claude
